notes.title: New! Make your own Mayhem update!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10022099/4a47eca7a9611c551f7c983391390c2741d5b14d.png
 Get Creative With the New Level Editor	

New to Mayhem Triple: a comprehensive level editor app, "Mayhem Maker!" Easily create your own adventures with custom sounds, graphics and cutscenes! When you've created your masterpiece, upload and share it on the Workshop for other players to check out. Hell, I'll probably play it...

 Bug Fixes	

    Fixed tontine upgrades. Some of them didn't work at all!
    Adjusted weapon balance.
    Adjusted camera positions and UI elements to be better centered.
    Changed the options menu and resolution/fullscreen code.
    Polished the last boss's behavior.
    Removed the clickteam fusion logo. I got the developer version now.
